changes: Radius selection opens in a compact pointer-anchored non-modal popup, without an overlay or background blur. Escape and outside clicks dismiss it; coordinates are expandable.
Removed the bottom graphics controls and their reserved 30px grid row. Rendering starts automatically and ignores the retired stored manual opt-out.
Measurement legends have an accessible close button. Visibility is remembered locally for that scale without changing colors or records, and can be restored in Views > Color by value.

The resource governor and representation compatibility checks automatically choose eligible prepared rendering or the standard fallback. Renderer comparisons use an internal QA hook, not a user control.
explanation: The KABR sample stores a 0–60 m height-above-takeoff color scale in its saved scenes. Loading the sample applies Color by value and displays this legend.
governor_verified: Injected critical memory pressure reduced actual framebuffer and geometry, retained exact data/selection/preferences, kept playback available, and recovered automatically through the capped profiles.

Map, Time and Globe render the updated interface without renderer errors
Smooth navigation prepares automatically in the native app without a user switch
Automatic native playback crosses all three views and pauses without losing source records

Rust backend, desktop native source and dependency locks are unchanged; the earlier 489-test backend run was not repeated for this frontend-only change.
